message: I was that gloriously over-prepared person the other day, running through my fire escape plan with my family like we were rehearsing a play. My kids were rolling their eyes, but you should’ve seen their faces light up when I pulled out our little smoke alarm tester — they loved feeling like heroes for a moment! 😄 It's funny how being a bit extra can turn safety into a family adventure. Do you have a fire drill planned this month?
